explanation: The WXC 350 is a motocross enduro model, while all catalog candidates are either motocross (FC 350), dual-sport (FX 350), or standard off-road (FE 350) models. The WXC 350 is a distinct model line with different geometry, suspension tuning, and intended use compared to the FC, FX, and FE series. No candidate shares the same underlying motorcycle identity.
